subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should #97971 be split into separate canonical docs/product items, and which remaining surfaces should core own after current bind, token, dry-run, and audit coverage plus open PR #98022?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the permanent core UX because the issue spans stable setup, update, auth, service, and audit contracts and several requested parts are already implemented or partly covered.

options.title: Split Remaining Core Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the parent, create or link focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diffs, and unified audit semantics, and let PR #98022 own only its narrower managed-service guard.

options.title: Close After Linking Narrow Items
options.body: Close this broad issue only after maintainers create canonical replacement issues for every remaining gap and explicitly decide that current coverage is enough for the rest.

options.title: Reject Broader Audit/Deploy Scope
options.body: Document that only the existing `gateway install --wrapper`, `openclaw update --dry-run`, and `openclaw audit` surfaces are supported, and route extra scripts or backup scheduling outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Remaining Core Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the parent, create or link focused follow-ups for systemd SecretRef docs, update config diffs, and unified audit semantics, and let PR #98022 own only its narrower managed-service guard.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans update, config audit, and gateway auth helpers, and this choice needs cross-surface product ownership rather than a single-file repair.
